summary.text: The Dark takes place across a war-ravaged Terisiare, where the Sylex Blast has blotted out the sun and an anti-magic religion blames wizards, who hide in the City of Shadows.
The story follows Maeveen O'Donagh, Vervamon and the young Yunnie, who holds the Sigil of Iwset, as Lord Peemel sends them in search of it and Peemel's war on Jehesic drags the north into conflict.

In the Urhaalan Valley the sorceress Sacumon manipulates the Niroso so that minotaurs and elves blame each other, and the group helps defeat her and end the war at great cost, while Yunnie's refusal of the throne ends the war between Iwset and Jehesic.
